narr: Slow moving thunderstorms produced very heavy rain and several areas of flash flooding across Eastern NC.
ev: Flooded roadways reported by Lenoir County EM in Kinston.
Public report via social media of flooded roads in downtown Kinston and Vernon Ave.
Jones County Emergency Manager reported water impacting HWY 41 and HWY 258 in western Jones County near Hargetts Crossroads. Time based on radar.

Martin County school district PIO called to report significant flooding ongoing along Prison Camp Road in Williamston. In that area, cars are flooded with water levels higher than the top of the tires.
Public reported flooded roads at S. McCaskey and S. Park.
The 911 center reported flooding on Fountaintown Rd.
Pitt County 911 center reported multiple roads flooded in downtown Greenville.
